name: arduino-servo-arm
description: Multi-servo robot arm with smooth (eased) motion: base/shoulder/elbow/gripper + a demo pick sequence. Serial control too.

files.content:
# Servo Robot Arm

4 hobby servos (base, shoulder, elbow, gripper) on pins 3/5/6/9. Move smoothly at `SPEED` deg/s toward targets; a demo pick-and-place runs when idle.

POWER: servos need their own 5-6V supply (a few amps) with a COMMON GROUND to the Arduino — do NOT run them off the board's 5V. Add a capacitor across the servo supply to reduce jitter. For 6+ servos use a PCA9685 (I2C, 16 channels).

Build: `arduino-cli compile --fqbn arduino:avr:uno servo_arm` then upload. ESP32: use <ESP32Servo.h>.
